dbToolScopingDenylist.areas: Public reference data (area names and centroids); no user data. Read via list-areas.
dbToolScopingDenylist.drugs: Public demo medicine catalog; no user data. Read via resolve-drug.
dbToolScopingDenylist.pharmacies: Shared pharmacy directory; no customer data. Read and written via pharmacy actions.
dbToolScopingDenylist.stock_observations: Global stock memory (pharmacy, drug, price, time); holds no user data by design.
